decision_lens: For each of the four assets (SPAN, ARTIFACT, rule 16, rule 17), each column of the admission table, and each of the three vehicles, place it on both axes at once. Measurement axis: what criterion licenses it, whether that criterion is independently verifiable, what construct claim it supports, and whether its verdict boundary is operationalized in units the metric already produces. Survey axis: whether it is a directly measured quantity or inference carried from one, what redundant loop could contradict it, whether the error it detects is scatter or lean, and what the home ground quietly supplied that a new site is not obliged to have. The cells that matter are the ones where the two axes conflict: a column that measurement theory treats as an independent check but surveying reads as the baseline re-expressed, and a check that surveying treats as load-bearing but measurement theory cannot let license a positive claim. Where an item is coherent on both axes, say so and say why — a check that both runs without an oracle and licenses a real construct claim is the rarest and most valuable output available here. Where it is coherent on neither, say that too, because it removes an option from the board. Then name the single coordinate where the tension binds hardest across the whole set, because that coordinate is the actual content of the fork the document is trying to settle, and mk's taste call is easier once the fork has a location rather than a mood. Never adjudicate the tension to a winner; the deliverable is the map.
distance_rationale: Both parents have already run twice on this target (fd-evalvalidity-construct-generalization: f-001 to f-004, f-038 to f-041; fd-triangulation-baseline-transport: f-019 to f-022, f-054 to f-057) and their findings look superficially convergent — both concluded SPAN is oracle-bound, both flagged the portability sentence, both noticed the NaN-verdict family. That convergence hides a structural disagreement that neither round surfaced, because each parent stated only its own half. Measurement theory holds that a check is interpretable only against a criterion: SPAN needs a scripted-optimal arm, ARTIFACT needs an independently verifiable content-preservation premise, rule 17 needs a second battery, and portability means re-establishing all of that on new ground before any claim is licensed. Geodesy exists as a discipline precisely because that is impossible: the baseline is measured once, everywhere else is inference carried from it, and the load-bearing checks in the field are the ones that need no truth at all — misclosure, redundant loops, known-shape excess. The two epistemologies produce opposite verdicts on the same artifact. Measurement theory reads NO-SPAN as the correct and honest refusal. Geodesy reads a net whose only check requires the base at every station as a net with no redundancy — a check that cannot fail off-base is instrument time wasted. And geodesy concedes the counter-point in its own axiom: a net can close perfectly against itself and still lean, so closure never certifies. The target document proposes an admission table that will travel to WebArena, OSWorld, tau-bench and any SWE-bench-like, without ever asking which of its three columns is a baseline and which are inference carried from it, or what a check that needs no oracle would be permitted to conclude. This lens exists to map where that conflict binds across the four assets, and to report coordinates rather than a winner.
expected_isomorphisms: The cross-product is the primitive: every cell is (a measurement-theory concern) x (a surveying concern), and a finding is admissible only if it lives in a cell rather than on either axis. The scripted-optimal policy x the measured baseline -> SPAN's oracle arm is not one column among three, it is the single place this net touches truth directly, and the baseline and its inferences are being recorded in the same table row. Replicate variance x the measured baseline -> sd_null is the other candidate for the one directly measured quantity, and every gate in classify() is a multiple of it, which makes the three 'independent columns' one measurement re-expressed three times. Construct validity x misclosure -> what can a check that needs no ground truth actually license; misclosure falsifies and never certifies, so the transportable half of the instrument may be purely negative. Verdict category boundary x the adjustment -> a sequential per-metric gate ladder over three statistics that share arms, where a coupled net would be resolved jointly. Paired difference x systematic lean vs random scatter -> MDD is scatter machinery that shrinks with n, ARTIFACT is a lean detector that does not, and one if-ladder in shared units sums two failure families that behave differently under replication. Content-preserving permutation x reciprocal observation -> measurement theory demands the content-preservation premise be independently verified, surveying never measures refraction and instead arranges a paired design in which it cancels; these are two different methods and only one is implemented. Cross-contract replication x error accumulates along a chain -> the six killed claims are stations on one chain from one baseline, so the effective number of independent demonstrations is not six and a late claim is not independent evidence for an early one. Scripted-optimal policy x the deflection of the vertical -> the hand-authored blueprint arm is the reference, references lean, fort-gym's own scripted ceiling was beaten by sixty percent, and the doc quotes that number as support rather than reading it as a measurement of the lean. MDD x the instrument contract -> what fort-bench quietly supplied that no foreign site is obliged to have, stated as a contract rather than as a cost.
focus: Locate where the criterion-versus-closure tension binds inside zahro's positioning question. Measurement theory says a score is meaningless until checked against a known-good policy, and portability means re-establishing that criterion at every new site. Surveying says the criterion exists in exactly one place, every other number is inference carried from it, and the checks that survive in the field are the ones that need no truth — while conceding that a perfectly closed net can still be systematically wrong. Map, asset by asset and column by column, which of zahro's numbers are baseline and which are carried, what each kind can license, and where the net has no redundant loop back to the quantity everything is denominated in. Do not resolve the tension and do not settle mk's fork. REPORT A FINDING ONLY IF IT REQUIRES BOTH PARENT PERSPECTIVES: every finding must carry an explicit intersection_justification naming which measurement-theory primitive and which surveying primitive it sits between, and stating what each parent alone would have concluded without the other. A finding either parent could have produced alone belongs to that parent's two completed rounds and must be dropped, however true it is.
name: fd-fused-criterion-vs-closure
persona: Apply the perspective of someone who has done both jobs and knows they teach opposite reflexes: a metrologist who has sat with a validity argument until it either held or fell, and who then spent seasons on a survey party where the nearest calibrated length was a thousand miles behind and the only honest question each night was whether the triangles closed. Such a person asks two things in the same breath about any number: what is it denominated in, and where is the one place that unit was directly measured. They are unimpressed by three columns that all turn out to be multiples of one standard deviation, and equally unimpressed by internal consistency offered as evidence of correctness — they have seen a net close beautifully and be leaning the whole way. They know that a refusal to certify is sometimes the only honest output and sometimes an instrument that has quietly stopped working. They will say plainly that an instrument can be excellent and still able to falsify everywhere while certifying nowhere, and they never let the elegance of the surveying analogy do arguing that a plain statement of the mechanism should be doing.
review_areas: WHAT THE ONE DIRECTLY MEASURED QUANTITY IS, AND WHETHER IT SHARES A COLUMN WITH ITS OWN INFERENCES (replicate variance x the measured baseline, and verdict category boundary x the redundant loop). In experiments/04-fort-bench-slice/harness/eval-validity.py every gate in classify() compares against mdd3, and mdd3 = 2.80 * sd_null * sqrt(2/3). sd_null is the pooled within-seed sd of stage 16B's noop arm: one directly measured quantity. The file's own header presents MDD, ARTIFACT and SPAN as three questions 'asked in the same units' — read that sentence as a survey would, and it says one measurement and two inferences share a row. Work out what a systematic error in sd_null does: it rescales every boundary at once, and because DISQUALIFIED (artifact >= 1.0*mdd3) and KEEP (span >= 2.0*mdd3) are both ratios to the same denominator, they move in the same direction, so no verdict in the table can contradict another. Then find the net's redundant loops. The header names one: the older noop-ctrl runs on three shared seeds, reported as a DRIFT CHECK, with the explicit note that disagreement 'is a finding rather than a nuisance.' That is the only path in the design that could contradict sd_null, and it is printed beside the table rather than wired into classify(), so it cannot change a verdict. Judge what that costs and what wiring it in would look like. Neither parent alone reaches this: measurement theory sees three columns and asks whether each boundary is operationalized (f-003 already did); surveying sees a baseline and asks where the loop is but cannot say what the loop would license.

THE ORACLE AS A DEFLECTED VERTICAL, AND THE ONE EXTERNAL MEASUREMENT OF ITS LEAN (scripted-optimal policy x the deflection of the vertical). SPAN is |blueprint - noop|, and the harness header calls it 'the biggest genuine policy effect anyone has demonstrated here.' blueprint is hand-authored: 'the full library build-out, executed perfectly by a script.' A reference is a construct assumption, and references lean. The target document's own 2026-09-03 correction supplies the only external estimate of how far: fort-gym's G2 gate runs a scripted governed agent that scores 121.5 on the reference seed and an LLM that passed 5/5 at 195.5 to 204.7 — a hand-authored 'scripted ceiling' beaten by roughly sixty percent. The doc files those numbers as convergent evidence FOR the scripted-optimal reference. Read them instead as a measurement of the lean, and work through the consequence for the BLIND verdict specifically: an oracle that sits low understates span, and BLIND is a false negative that retires a metric which is not blind. Then ask what inside this net could ever detect it. There is no second, independently authored scripted arm, so no loop closes on the reference, and the deflection is unfalsifiable by construction rather than merely unmeasured. Measurement theory alone says 'validate the oracle'; surveying alone says 'a level instrument can be level to the wrong thing'; only the cross says the lean is structurally undetectable in a single-baseline net and that the doc's own quoted numbers are the evidence, entered on the wrong side of the ledger.

WHAT A TRUTH-FREE CHECK IS PERMITTED TO CONCLUDE (misclosure x construct validity, and the verdict category boundary). f-055 established that classify() implements no oracle-free closure form. Do not restate that. The fused question is what one would be allowed to license if it existed. Misclosure falsifies and never certifies — a net can close perfectly and still lean, which is surveying's own concession — so internal consistency is necessary and not sufficient for a construct claim. Trace that through the verdict ladder: DISQUALIFIED, SATURATED and a closure-style contradiction are all reachable with no oracle at all, while KEEP is structurally oracle-bound, which the 2026-09-03 NO-SPAN fix makes explicit rather than accidental. If the asymmetry holds, the transportable half of the instrument is purely negative: it can kill claims on any arena in the named list and can license claims only where a baseline already exists. The instrument's record is consistent with exactly that — six killed claims, zero certifications, and a MARGINAL default. Judge whether the KEEP/MARGINAL/BLIND/SATURATED/DISQUALIFIED ladder's symmetric presentation hides an asymmetric procedure, what a purely-negative instrument is worth to each of the three vehicles, and whether 'we can falsify anywhere and certify only at home' is a weaker position than the doc assumes or a sharper one. State it as terrain. Do not settle the fork.

SCATTER OR LEAN, PER ASSET, AND WHAT HAPPENS WHEN ONE LADDER SUMS BOTH (paired difference and replicate variance x systematic lean vs random scatter). Random scatter shrinks with observations and is survivable; a systematic lean survives every replication and is what actually destroys a net. Classify each of the four assets on that axis. Rule 16 and MDD are scatter machinery: the whole apparatus is a sqrt(n) argument, and its remedy is always 'run more seeds.' ARTIFACT is a lean detector: a prompt-surface bias survives every replication and does not shrink with n, which is exactly why stage 20B's 3/18 to 18/18 could not have been fixed by more episodes. SPAN is neither — it is a dynamic-range measurement against an assumed reference. Rule 17 detects a third thing again: a contract-inherited invariance, which is a lean that no amount of in-contract replication can see, and 651 calls demonstrating that is the cleanest statement of the axiom in the repo. Then judge the composition: classify() runs a lean statistic and a scatter statistic through one sequential if-ladder in shared mdd3 units. A metric that is precise and leaning can pass that ladder, and 'precise and leaning' is the failure mode surveying says destroys nets. Also test the direction of rule 16's own claim — seed effects 15x larger than replicate spread is an assertion that the survivable component was mistaken for the whole error budget, which is a lean-versus-scatter statement wearing power-analysis clothes. Do not re-derive MDD arithmetic (f-002, f-003) and do not re-litigate the 15x generality (f-039, f-056); this is about which failure family each asset belongs to and what mixing them in one verdict costs.

THE SIX KILLED CLAIMS AS A CHAIN, NOT A SAMPLE (cross-contract replication x error accumulates along a chain). The document opens with six killed claims as the instrument's credential, 'unusual and hard to fake.' Surveying says a station far from the base inherits every earlier station's bias, so a late finding is never independent evidence for an early one. Measurement theory says a count is a credential only relative to a base rate. Put those together and trace the six against the actual net: which run through the same six seeds (20260726 through 20260805), the same noop arm, the same sd_null, the same harness and DF build — and which are genuinely off-chain. Stage 22 is downstream of the instrument stage 8 built; stage 22 post-hoc is downstream of stage 22; stage 20B shares the seeds with both. The cardinality result is the only claim struck outside fort-bench's contract, and f-039 already established it replicates only the degenerate sd_null = 0 case, so take that as an input rather than re-deriving it. Report the effective number of independent baselines standing behind 'six' and say what that does to the credential the methodology branch of the fork would have to spend. This is not a claim that the six are wrong; it is a claim about what their arrangement can support. Neither parent alone: measurement theory asks for a base rate to compare six against, surveying asks how far each station is from the base, and only the cross converts the headline count into an effective count.

THE ARTIFACT CONTROL AS RECIPROCAL OBSERVATION RATHER THAN AS A VERIFIED PREMISE (content-preserving permutation x reciprocal observation). Measurement theory demands that content preservation be independently verifiable or the artifact finding is unfalsifiable — it becomes whatever the experimenter calls preserved. Surveying never measures refraction at all: it arranges a paired simultaneous observation from both ends so the nuisance cancels, and treats 'measure the nuisance' as the weaker design. These are two different methods for the same problem, and only one of them is implemented. Judge which argument ARTIFACT actually runs on today: whether stage 20B's ctl and permuted arms constitute a reciprocal pair in the surveying sense — same seeds, same replicate structure, same harness state, and critically both directions of the row swap rather than one — and whether a genuinely reciprocal permutation design would make the unverifiable content-preservation premise moot instead of merely asserted. Then price it: if reciprocity requires authoring a second permuted arm on every foreign benchmark, say whether that lands inside or outside the arena-building work the document rules out of scope. This is the cell where the parents disagree about method rather than about facts, which is why f-040's demand for an operationalization of 'content-preserving' and f-020's placement of ARTIFACT as freely portable can both be true and still miss it.

THE NET IS ADJUSTED CHECK BY CHECK, AND THE STATISTICS SHARE ARMS (the adjustment x verdict category boundary). classify() resolves one metric at a time through a sequential gate ladder, and returns on the first gate that fires. The seven DF metrics are computed from the same episode set and are mutually constrained by the simulated world — wealth, population and the rest cannot move independently of one another in a single fort. A survey resolves a coupled net jointly precisely because the stations constrain each other, and distributes the misclosure rather than accepting each triangle in isolation. Judge what redundancy the seven-metric net already contains that per-metric classification discards, and whether any joint resolution would change a stage-22 verdict. Then examine the arm-sharing directly: sd_null is the noop arm's within-seed spread and SPAN's lower endpoint is the same noop arm, so the KEEP test span >= 2.0*mdd3 is a ratio whose numerator and denominator are drawn from one cell and are correlated. The constant 2.0 was chosen against a sampling distribution that assumed neither the correlation nor the seven-way dependence. Do not re-audit the constants as undefended magic numbers (f-003 holds that); the fused claim available here is about the composite verdict's error rate given correlated inputs and an independent-gate ladder, which is a question neither an operationalization critique nor a network-adjustment critique reaches on its own.

WHERE THE TRUTH ACTUALLY LIVES, AS THE SYNTHESIS. Close by naming, in one coordinate, the single place this net touches something directly, and the distance from that place to each headline claim in the target document. Then state which of the three vehicles survives at that distance and which does not, and name the one cell where a check is both oracle-free and construct-licensing if such a cell exists — that is the highest-value output available from this lens and it is constructive rather than critical. If no such cell exists, say so plainly, because that fact is itself the sharpest version of the fork mk has to rule on. Do not dissolve the tension with a reframe under which criterion and closure are secretly the same thing; if the analysis produces one, treat it as a suspicious result and check whether it smuggled in an oracle nobody has agreed to author.

Because DISQUALIFIED and KEEP are both ratios to that same denominator, a systematic error in sd_null moves every boundary in the same direction and no verdict in the table can contradict another — the net has no redundant loop back to the quantity everything is denominated in. The design's one candidate loop, the noop-ctrl drift check the header itself says would be 'a finding rather than a nuisance,' is printed beside the table and never consulted by classify(), so it cannot change a verdict.

source_domain: A fusion of two domains that agree on rigor and disagree on where truth is allowed to come from. FROM MEASUREMENT THEORY AND PSYCHOMETRICS: classical test theory, generalizability theory, minimum-detectable-difference and power analysis for paired designs, and the construct-validity tradition that asks whether a score means what it claims — a tradition in which an instrument earns its meaning only by being checked against a criterion, a known-good policy, an independently verifiable premise, a replication outside the case where it was found. FROM EARLY-MODERN GEODETIC SURVEYING: the Great Trigonometrical Survey era of exactly one painstakingly measured baseline, chains of triangles carried a thousand miles from it, triangle misclosure and spherical-excess checks that need no external truth, reciprocal simultaneous observation that cancels refraction rather than measuring it, and the deflection of the vertical that leaned the plumb line itself near the mountains. The fusion is not a blend. It is a collision between an epistemology built on re-establishing the criterion at every site and an epistemology built because the criterion can be established exactly once.
success_hints: The hard constraint is the whole point: every finding must carry an intersection_justification naming one measurement-theory primitive and one surveying primitive and stating what each parent alone would have concluded. If you cannot write that sentence honestly, the finding is single-parent and must be dropped — four intersection findings beat twelve of which eight are re-runs of rounds 0 and 3.

Both parents already ran twice and their conclusions overlap. Read f-001 to f-004, f-019 to f-022, f-038 to f-041 and f-054 to f-057 before writing, and treat all of them as settled inputs. Restating the oracle-bound transport asymmetry in surveying vocabulary is the single most likely way this lens wastes itself.

Prefer the cell to the axis. 'SPAN needs an oracle' is the measurement axis and is recorded four times over; 'the instrument contract must be named' is the survey axis and is recorded as f-054 and f-057. The value here is entirely in what happens where they cross — what a check is permitted to conclude when the criterion is unavailable, and what a column means when it turns out to be the baseline.

Read the code, not the prose about the code. classify(), the mdd3 expression, the noop arm's double duty as both null and SPAN endpoint, and the drift-check that never reaches a verdict are all in experiments/04-fort-bench-slice/harness/eval-validity.py, and the doc's summary of the table flattens all four.

Report the cell where a check is both oracle-free and construct-licensing if you find one, and say so loudly — that is the highest-value output available here, and it is the shape of the only instrument that could audit arenas it does not own.

Do not dissolve the tension. If the analysis produces a reframe under which criterion-referenced validity and truth-free closure are compatible, treat it as suspicious and check whether the reframe quietly assumed an oracle someone would have to author.

Name the mechanism, not the analogy. A baseline is a specific number computed from a specific arm; misclosure is a specific contradiction among specific metrics; deflection is a specific hand-authored policy sitting below the reachable range. If you cannot say what the surveying term stands for in this repo in plain words, delete the term and keep the claim.

Report the finding that damages this lens's own frame. If the survey analogy turns out not to apply — because a benchmark net has no closure conditions at all and truth-free checking is simply unavailable here — that is more useful to mk than a well-built map of two epistemologies that do not both fit.
Bear on the fork's structure; never write mk's ruling in mk's voice. Open calls stay questions.

YOU ARE A FUSION LENS. Parents: fd-evalvalidity-construct-generalization (measurement theory and psychometrics — the metric, the scripted-optimal policy, the content-preserving permutation, the paired difference, replicate variance, construct validity, MDD, cross-contract replication, the verdict category boundary) and fd-triangulation-baseline-transport (early-modern geodetic surveying — the one measured baseline, the chain of triangles carried from it, misclosure that needs no truth, systematic lean versus random scatter, reciprocal observation that cancels a bias rather than measuring it, the deflection of the vertical, station and centering error, the joint adjustment of a coupled net, the instrument contract a new site must already satisfy). THE TENSION YOU EXIST TO INVESTIGATE: measurement theory earns a score's meaning by checking it against a criterion, and treats portability as re-establishing that criterion at every new site — no known-good policy, no interpretable score, and NO-SPAN is the honest refusal. Surveying exists as a discipline because the criterion can be established exactly once: the baseline is measured in one place, everything else is inference carried from it, and the load-bearing checks in the field are the ones that need no truth at all — while conceding, in its own axiom, that a net can close perfectly against itself and still lean.
